design_selected: 4 tasks x 4 CLIs x 3 repetitions = 48 planned slots
fixture_origin: Proposed supervisor-authored synthetic Python stdlib fixtures; not third-party source

tasks.grading: 10-point structured oracle; success requires 10/10, valid JSON, scope and CLI completion
rubric: default: correct value 1 point; valid evidence reference 1 point
precedence: correct complete order 1 point; valid evidence reference 1 point
alias_trace: correct complete trace 1 point; valid evidence reference 1 point
cycle_error: correct type AND message 1 point; valid evidence reference 1 point
mutation: correct boolean 1 point; valid evidence reference 1 point
acceptance_matrix: Missing/malformed JSON, duplicate keys, missing/unknown fields and wrong JSON types rejected
Exact expected values/trace/error from pinned fixture; array order significant
References validated against per-question allowlist of real path:symbol; not free-text keyword matching
Partial scores reported but not counted as success
No modification of source/public tests; answer-only scope enforced
pending: fixture behavior and actual oracle values

acceptance_matrix: Empty outer iterable and empty pages
List and one-shot generator inputs; consume each exactly once
First appearance determines output position; last duplicate supplies full record
Replacement is not a merge of old and new fields
No mutation of pages/records; output dictionaries are independent shallow copies
Repeated calls do not share state; duplicate IDs within and across pages
No-TTL entries persist; expiry at now >= deadline including equality
Injected nondecreasing clock only; no real sleeping/time dependence
LRU eviction; hit and set refresh recency, miss and len do not
Expired entries purged before capacity enforcement and len
Overwrite updates value/deadline/recency without increasing live size
ttl <= 0 removes existing key and stores nothing
None value, custom default, delete hit/miss/expired and independent instances

tasks.grading: scope + behavior regression + structural contract + CLI completion
acceptance_matrix: Existing router.dispatch signature/import path preserved
create/update/delete success, validation failures and unknown command match frozen old behavior
Returned values, exception types/messages, mutation and independent-call behavior preserved
routing.validation.validate_payload and routing.handlers.handle_create/handle_update/handle_delete callable directly
Dispatcher delegates to new functions; not unused duplicate modules or behavior left entirely in old dispatcher
No module import side effects or new dependencies
